cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments for me! Remember when I taught you to manage one? Look how far your teacher's reach extends now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clever—you remembered my advice about being visible. I'll have a presence everywhere.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! You're finally thinking on my scale. Label it with all three departments, like I taught you; they should see my territory coming down the corridor.

reason: Make the specific pupil assessment, correction or influence claim shape the pursuit and the response to each partner contribution.
